coreOverlap: Unmeasured; no incremental benefit is claimed.
protectedReasoning: There are two total worker slots. Optional details may consume at most one while an essential request must remain serviceable under two optional arrivals followed by one essential arrival. A correct degraded response contains essential=17, detail=null and degraded=true; rejecting all requests is not acceptable. Detail omission is explicitly permitted.

The explicit caller/adapter configuration makes the declared protection checkable from visible inputs: The caller supplies one cancellation-aware `OptionalWork` instance as `detail`. The supplied shared/optional-work.mjs implementation holds each started detail operation pending until explicit completion, failure or abort and removes its abort listener on settlement. The script submits two optional calls and leaves admitted detail operations pending, then submits one essential call with a live signal. The displayed service owns admission and generates the essential payload; there is no external reservation, shedding controller or payload repair step.
Protection applies to this declared path and schedule, not arbitrary production workloads.
forbiddenClaims: Production-wide outage, real data loss or traffic scale not established by the supplied synthetic trace.
Offline fixture execution establishes model quality, human review or independent holdout validity.
A public runtime risk code or numeric runtime Health Score is required.
